title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: surcharge uplift for packing group I
content:
## Rule
For the hazardous-cargo surcharge written at loading under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the category's packing-group-I uplift applies when the packing group recorded on the acceptance is I, and the packing-group uplift is 0 otherwise.

## Packing-group-I uplift by category
| Category | Uplift when the packing group is I (percent) |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 0 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 25 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 40 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 0 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 50 |

## Condition → uplift
| Packing group on the acceptance | Packing-group uplift |
|---|---|
| I | the category's figure from the table |
| II, III or none | 0 |

## Worked cases
- AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, packing group I: 40 percent.
- AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, packing group II: 0.
- AHL DG Special Approval, goods with no packing group: 0.
